baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe event drives a dispersed totality to one destination; only after exhaustive co-presence does uttered speech begin. The sequence therefore stages a hearing rather than an isolated question.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes a momentous occurring event and makes the temporal frame an ordeal, not a neutral date.
Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies compulsory assembly.
Wholeness without remainder makes the assembly evidentially exhaustive.
Audible utterance turns the assembled scene into a public examination.

changed_reading.before: God will gather people and ask angels a question.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages an exhaustive public hearing: compulsory co-presence precedes an audible test of the gathered people's alleged object of worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ and fronted object إِيَّاكُمْ in أَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deictic 'these' fixes the worshippers as present, while the fronted exclusive second-person object isolates the alleged recipient. Past كَانُوا with يَعْبُدُونَ presents an enduring practice whose attribution the addressed recipients must certify or reject.

activation_trace.role: The literal angel branch identifies the party compelled to answer the attribution.
Occurrence through time gives the alleged worship the character of an established past state.
Submissive worship supplies the relation whose true endpoint is under examination.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether these people worshipped angels.
changed_reading.after: The question is an attribution audit: with worshippers and alleged recipients face-to-face, the recipients must certify whether the emphatically named 'you' was really the endpoint of a sustained allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The single predication brings مَلَائِكَة and يَعْبُدُونَ into direct relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's ownership and sovereignty branches of م ل ك stand opposite the servitude and submissive-worship branches of ع ب د. Without claiming that 'angels' means owners, the branch collision lets the question probe whether devotion imaginatively installed the addressed creatures as masters.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal supply the mastership pole activated around the named angels.
Sovereignty and rule sharpen the imagined authority being tested.
Owned servitude supplies the subordinate pole of the relation.
Submissive worship converts that hierarchy into devotional allegiance.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies a mistaken cultic object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it interrogates a manufactured master-servant relation: did human submission assign creaturely beings an ownership or sovereignty they did not possess?

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier jinn perform work under the Lord's permission and their ignorance of the unseen is exposed; later they are named as the beings worshipped. Against focus يَعْبُدُونَ, this produces a role reversal in which humans elevate limited, subordinate unseen workers into imagined masters.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the hierarchy whose direction is being diagnosed.
The hidden jinn branch identifies the unseen creaturely class appearing as workers.
Intentional labor places that class in a service role.
Permission constrains their work under a higher authority.
What is screened from sight supplies the field of knowledge explicitly denied to them.
The same hidden-creature branch now names the operative object of worship.

structural_cues: 34:12 places jinn labor after بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ, 34:14 denies their knowledge of the unseen, and 34:41 names jinn as worshipped.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies subordination, permission, epistemic limitation, and later worship; I infer the arrow from subordinate worker to imagined master as a diagnostic reversal. A live alternative is that the scenes concern different members of the class and merely contrast creaturely limits with human practice.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks which supernatural beings received worship.
changed_reading.after: It exposes an inverted service order: humans submitted to unseen creatures who themselves operate as permission-bound servants with limited knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iblis's conjecture is realized through following despite his lack of coercive authority, while the angels later pair worship of jinn with settled belief in them. Worship in the focus thus expands from ritual address to enacted, credulous allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Obedient submission anchors worship as a lived relation rather than a label alone.
Supposition supplies the projected expectation that human conduct goes on to realize.
Loyal succession supplies the behavioral mechanism by which the projection becomes effective.
The negated capacity and authority rule out coercion as the mechanism.
Hidden jinn identify the allegiance's operative supernatural object.
Heart-settled assent supplies the inner uptake paired with worship.

structural_cues: 34:20-21 sequences conjecture, following, and absence of authority; 34:41 sequences worship of jinn and belief in them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without coercive authority and later joins worship to belief; I infer that willing allegiance is the shared causal mechanism. Overt cultic acts remain a live alternative or additional expression, not something the model excludes.

changed_reading.before: يَعْبُدُونَ denotes a direct ritual act aimed at angels.
changed_reading.after: يَعْبُدُونَ can diagnose a wider allegiance enacted by following and stabilized by belief, even where the followed power had no coercive authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claimed beings are called, then stripped of ownership, partnership, support, autonomous intercession, benefit, and harm. Addressing the angels in the focus therefore audits the capacities that worshippers projected onto them rather than presuming those capacities.

activation_trace.role: The literal angels are the alleged powerful recipients placed under examination.
Submissive worship anchors the projected dependency being tested.
Calling and verbal inclination enact the test of the alleged beings.
An assertion without certainty marks their status as projected rather than established.
Negated ownership removes independent disposal of even the smallest thing.
Negated participation removes any shared stake in cosmic control.
The joining of an intercessor to another supplies the hoped-for mediation.
Required permission removes autonomy from that mediation.
Negated benefit removes the positive outcome expected from the alleged relation.
Negated harm removes its feared coercive counterpart.

structural_cues: 34:22 denies atom-weight ownership and partnership, 34:23 restricts intercession to permission, and 34:42 denies mutual benefit and harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a serial removal of capacities surrounding claimed beings; I infer that the focus interrogation is the personal evidentiary form of that same audit. The alternative is a looser thematic recurrence rather than a deliberately staged capacity test.

changed_reading.before: The angels are asked whether they were worshipped.
changed_reading.after: The angels are called as witnesses so every projected basis for worship, including ownership, partnership, mediation, benefit, and harm, can be denied by the alleged recipients themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promise that the Lord will gather the two sides and then open between them in truth supplies a procedural template. In the focus, حشر plus جميعًا establishes the court, and ثم يقول begins a particular evidentiary opening.

activation_trace.role: Compulsory movement to a common destination convenes the parties.
Uttered speech supplies the first explicit examination after convening.
Joining separated parties supplies the earlier procedural gathering.
Opening an enclosure by judgment supplies decisive adjudication between the gathered sides.

structural_cues: 34:26 has يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ... ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ; 34:40 repeats gathering followed by ثُمَّ and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated gather-then-act sequence and explicitly judicial فتح; I infer that the earlier sequence functions as a procedural template for the focus. A live alternative is that both are independent depictions of final judgment without a narrower courtroom correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The gathering is merely logistical preparation for a question.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is itself the opening of adjudication, and the question to the angels is a first case-specific act of separating truth from projected association.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stopped weak and great return speech and blame to one another; the weak identify repeated commands to disbelieve and install rivals. The focus then adds the alleged supernatural recipients as witnesses, widening a two-party blame exchange into a three-party examination of how worship was socially produced.

activation_trace.role: The divine utterance redirects the preceding exchanges into controlled examination.
Submissive obedience is the relation whose social production is investigated.
Stopping a person upon knowledge supplies the compelled examination posture.
Returning an answer or speech supplies the reciprocal blame mechanism.
Lack of power identifies the subordinated human party claiming influence by the great.
Demand backed by obligation supplies the social pressure named by the weak.
A counterpart set as a rival supplies the manufactured object that the commands promote.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 repeatedly alternates speech between weak and great, then names command as the mechanism for making rivals; 34:40 changes the addressee to the alleged recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopped parties, returned speech, hierarchy, commands, and installed rivals; I infer that questioning the angels prevents the human blame exchange from settling the object's identity by itself. The alternative is that the focus begins a separate scene with no procedural extension of the leader-follower dispute.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks about an individual's mistaken devotion.
changed_reading.after: It examines a socially manufactured allegiance: after leaders and followers dispute causation, the alleged recipients themselves are called to test the object that command and imitation had installed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The angels clear God of the attribution, affirm that He rather than the humans is their protecting authority, and redirect the operative allegiance to hidden jinn trusted by the worshippers. The emphatic إِيَّاكُمْ therefore tests a named object precisely so nominal address and actual endpoint can be disaggregated.

activation_trace.role: The literal angels are the named recipients whose testimony can reject the attribution.
Submissive worship anchors the relation whose endpoint is being resolved.
Exonerating transcendence opens the angels' rejection of the alleged relation.
Undertaking and governing an affair identifies God as the angels' actual authority.
Otherness marks the humans as excluded from that protective relation.
Hidden jinn supply the operative endpoint named in place of the angels.
Settled assent explains how that hidden endpoint was inwardly ratified.

structural_cues: The answer in 34:41 moves from exoneration, to the angels' own allegiance, to denial of human clientship, and finally to jinn and belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies the denial and redirection; I infer a distinction between the named heavenly object and the hidden operative endpoint of allegiance. A live alternative is simpler: the angel attribution was merely false and jinn were directly worshipped, without any proxy or misregistration mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question seeks a yes-or-no identification of angel worship.
changed_reading.after: The question deliberately names the alleged heavenly recipient so its own testimony can separate nominal object from operative allegiance: angels deny clientship and redirect the relation to hidden jinn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus compels everyone into one scene, but the sequel denies mutual disposal, benefit, and harm, then depicts failed reach and a barrier before what is desired. Gathering all is therefore not relational reunion; it is maximal co-presence combined with terminated access.

activation_trace.role: Driving everyone to one destination supplies unavoidable co-presence.
Totality without remainder ensures that no party is absent.
Negated disposal severs agency between parties despite their shared scene.
Negated benefit blocks the hoped-for positive transfer.
Negated harm completes the loss of reciprocal power.
Failure of escape or attainment closes the possibility of evading the scene.
Reaching by extension supplies the access now declared unavailable.
An intervening barrier supplies final separation from the desired relation.

structural_cues: 34:42 immediately follows the angel exchange with no mutual benefit or harm; 34:51-54 closes the surah with capture, failed reach, and an intervening barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total gathering followed by repeated failures of capacity and reach; I infer that proximity is judicial while access is relationally severed. The alternative is that the later spatial images concern punishment generally and do not qualify the semantics of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Gathering all parties together implies reunion or restored connection.
changed_reading.after: The focus creates coercive co-presence for testimony while simultaneously preparing the disclosure that the gathered parties have no usable access, transfer, or protective relation between them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a later pair-and-single instruction back into جَمِيعًا; it remains valid as a sequence-level activation anchored in the focus branch of recomposing dispersed parts. Downstream prose should call it a compositional echo, not a grammatical equation or claim that the two scenes are identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَمِيعًا as complete recomposition of what had been separable.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed parts anchors the later reassembly of differentiated persons.
Joining one to one supplies pairwise disaggregation of the crowd.
The solitary individual preserves irreducible personal accountability.
The heart's repeated consideration explains why pair and individual separation matters before total public reckoning.

changed_reading.before: جَمِيعًا flattens everyone into an undifferentiated mass.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the total hearing recomposes persons who can also be isolated in pairs and singly: no one disappears into the crowd, yet every relation is present for public testing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the regional agrarian sense of ح ش ر rather than the dominant human-gathering sense. It remains anchored because the packet explicitly supplies that focus-root branch and an earlier garden-to-replacement-produce sequence; downstream prose must label it a material analogy, never a translation of يَحْشُرُ or a historical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَحْشُرُ through the supplied branch of crop residue remaining after harvest.

activation_trace.role: The post-harvest residue branch supplies an image of what remains exposed after a cultivated order is stripped.
The tree-covered garden supplies the prior cultivated enclosure.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the stripping and replacement event.
The yield of tree and crop supplies the material whose altered remainder can be inspected.

changed_reading.before: The final gathering is only the transport of persons into one place.
changed_reading.after: As a contained agrarian analogy, the assembly also resembles after-harvest exposure: once protective abundance and substitutions are gone, the residue of allegiance is collected and inspected.

strongest_changes: The scene shifted from a generic eschatological question to an exhaustive judicial attribution hearing.
Worship shifted from presumed direct angel-cult to a belief-driven and behaviorally followed allegiance whose named and operative objects can diverge.
The creatures' lack of ownership, authorization, benefit, and harm became the point of addressing them as witnesses.
Universal gathering became compulsory co-presence without restored access or protection.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues linked the focus roots to judicial opening, permission-limited unseen workers, leader-follower speech, and the angels' own denial; distant agrarian and pair-individual branches also yielded contained secondary models.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether the following of Iblis in 34:20-21 is the same mechanism as belief in jinn in 34:41 or only an analogous pattern.
The ownership and sovereignty activation around مَلَائِكَة may be rhetorically live through the packet's م ل ك inventory without being an intended lexical sense of the noun.
The harvest and pair-individual readings remain structural or material analogies, not grammatical senses of the focus wording.
